mirror_epoch.cause: the in-process evaluation after step 1 read FP16 projection mirrors converted from pre-step masters; LayerNorm and embedding masters were current, so the loss landed between the initial and updated checkpoints
mirror_epoch.fix: publish the master epoch after the submitted optimizer step (VulkanTransformer::train_step), so a between-step evaluation converts its mirrors from the post-step masters
mirror_epoch.conclusion: the +0.302353 step-one gap was an evaluation-lag artifact; the step-100 mixed/FP32 gap is reproduced by fresh-process evaluation of the exported weights and remains a real drift
